changelog:
- Initial release of Prompt Polisher.
- Transforms rough, vague, or scattered user requests into clear, actionable prompts with explicit goals, constraints, output format, and assumptions.
- Ensures prompts are concise, well-structured, and preserve the original user intent.
- Automatically identifies and addresses missing but necessary details, explicitly labeling any assumptions made.
- Provides the option to include follow-up questions when key information is lacking.
